title: Browser Agents and Indirect Prompt Injection — Agents That Use the Web
titleKn: Browser Agents ಮತ್ತು ಪರೋಕ್ಷ Prompt Injection — ವೆಬ್ ಬಳಸುವ Agents
desc: Browser agents click, type and read pages on a user's behalf, which exposes them to whatever those pages contain.
objectives: Describe what a browser agent can do.
Explain why open web content is untrusted.

title: Browser Agents and Indirect Prompt Injection — How Indirect Injection Attacks Work
titleKn: Browser Agents ಮತ್ತು ಪರೋಕ್ಷ Prompt Injection — ಪರೋಕ್ಷ Injection ದಾಳಿ ಹೇಗೆ
desc: Attackers hide instructions in pages, emails or documents so the agent acts for them instead of the user.
objectives: Describe hidden text and disguised instructions.
Trace an example from injection to harmful action.
objectivesKn: ಗುಪ್ತ ಪಠ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ವೇಷಧಾರಿ ಸೂಚನೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
injection ನಿಂದ ಹಾನಿಕರ ಕ್ರಿಯೆವರೆಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ.

title: Browser Agents and Indirect Prompt Injection — Defending Browser Agents
titleKn: Browser Agents ಮತ್ತು ಪರೋಕ್ಷ Prompt Injection — Browser Agents ರಕ್ಷಣೆ
desc: Reduce risk with confirmation for sensitive actions, limited access, site restrictions and monitoring.
objectives: Limit what the agent can access at once.
